name: Terrarium 130x22x20 +3D
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 130x22x20 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 57.2 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This model has unusual proportions: 130 cm of length, but only 22 cm of width and 20 cm of height. The volume is about 57 liters, and the floor is 2860 cm² in the shape of a long strip. A 3D background of carved styrofoam runs the whole length of the back, so the terrarium looks like a slice of rock on a shelf.

Because of the 22 cm width it is not for adult bearded dragons, tortoises or larger pythons, as they have nowhere to turn around. It suits young snakes, which move along the wall anyway, and small ground-dwelling species. The 130 cm length gives a long temperature gradient: heating goes at one end, and the other stays at room temperature.

It is intended for a long shelf or a niche above a dresser, where a classic terrarium does not fit. If you have such a spot with different dimensions, we will build it to fit exactly. Because of the 130 cm length, arrange delivery with us before ordering, and the build takes 7 to 14 days. The outer sides of this model can also get a film in one of 34 patterns.
